paragraphs: Brooks Lee was the lone former Mustang to appear in a confirmed professional game on Monday, batted 6th and started at 3B for Minnesota Twins against Baltimore Orioles. Minnesota Twins beat Baltimore Orioles, 9-5.
Brooks Lee produced a double in the fourth, on a 3-2 pitch 84 mph cutter from Trevor Rogers.
title: Brooks Lee in the lineup as Minnesota Twins wins
